title: Academy Award for Best Animated Feature
categories: Awards for best animated feature film

fields.Awarded for: The best animated film with a running time of more than 40 minutes, a significant number of the major characters animated, and at least 75 percent of the picture's running time including animation.
fields.Presented by: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS)
fields.Most nominations: Pixar (20) / Pete Docter, Byron Howard, Hayao Miyazaki, and Chris Sanders (4)
